prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1120; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed first notice of loss. Insured reports a left-turn collision at an intersection with a vehicle traveling straight through. Insured states the oncoming vehicle entered on a yellow signal. Police report requested. No citations issued at scene per initial report.

Entry 2: Contacted the other driver's carrier to confirm liability coverage limits and open a claim. Liability position under review given conflicting accounts of signal phase. Scene photos received from insured show damage to front quarter panel and passenger door.

Entry 3: Claimant contacted the office and reports neck and lower back strain following the collision. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has not yet provided medical records. Advised claimant of the process for submitting bills and treatment notes. Requested authorization to obtain records from treating provider.

Entry 4: Received signed medical authorization from claimant. Treating clinic notes indicate a diagnosis of lower back strain with a recommendation for physical therapy and follow-up in two weeks. No fractures or imaging-confirmed injuries reported at this stage. Injury evaluation ongoing.

Entry 5: Spoke with claimant regarding status. Claimant reports ongoing back pain and is attending physical therapy. Claimant has not raised concerns about the claim handling process. Reserve reviewed and file remains open pending records from the physical therapy provider and completion of the liability determination.
